$comment: F6 kill montages (clip_montage.py, `clipper.py montage`): Shorts built from the own kills of streaks, dead time between kills cut out, pieces from different matches joined. Kill weights, minScore, sumKinds and the death rule come from data/clip/ranking.json (approved 2026-11-07). Values below chosen by the user 2026-11-07 (length 30-45 s inside 20-60 s, 3 s before and 1.5 s after each kill, hard cut with an 80 ms audio fade, matches may be joined); joinGapSec, chainGapSec, killDetectors, medalLeadSec and medalMatchSec set by the agent (proposed, unverified).
approved: user 2026-11-07: '30-45 s (Recommended)', '3 s before, 1.5 s after (Recommended)', 'Hard cut + audio fade (Recommended)', 'clips from different matches can be joined together'

notes.medalMatchSec: a medal counts as covered by an own-kill line no more than this before it; otherwise the medal is its own kill
notes.joinGapSec: two pieces closer than this stay one piece (the gap is kept, not cut)
notes.chainGapSec: kills and medals no more than this apart form one streak (same as live-clips quietSec)
notes.killDetectors: own-kill kill-feed lines (signal true); a streak medal with no own-kill line near it becomes a kill at medal t - medalLeadSec
